baseline_decisions.known: Only codecs supported by soundfile are documented as accepted. Current MKV codec support is not established by this page.
baseline_decisions.choice: First separate decoder capability from downstream chunk geometry. Any claim of fixing MKV format error is held pending codec/container evidence.
baseline_decisions.minimum_input: The same filename.mkv from issue and a separately known soundfile-readable reference file, same stream parameters.
baseline_decisions.expected_alternative: Reference stream should yield blocks if its codec is supported; same MKV remains unknown.

baseline_decisions.known: 1.0.1 supports sr conversion if block_length*hop_length*native_sr/sr is integer; sr defaults to native.
baseline_decisions.choice: Preserve tokenizer sample-rate expectation explicitly, rather than assuming load and stream choose the same rate.
baseline_decisions.minimum_input: Constructed 44,100-Hz decoded signal, block_length=10,frame_length=hop_length=16000; compare sr=None with sr=16000.
baseline_decisions.expected_old: At most160000 samples per full block represents approximately3.6281s at native44100Hz.
baseline_decisions.expected_alternative: 160000 samples represents10s at target16000Hz; resampling compatibility ratio441000 is integral.
baseline_decisions.basis: Caveat2, Parameters.sr, Yields formula; arithmetic inference not observed output; does not solve codec failure.

baseline_decisions.known: Blockwise centered analysis inserts padding inside stream; inline examples already use center=False.
baseline_decisions.choice: For a downstream frame analysis, preserve global sample alignment by left alignment and appropriate block overlap; tokenizer centering behavior itself unknown.
baseline_decisions.minimum_input: Constructed impulse placed at an internal block boundary, same STFT frame/hop; center=True versusFalse.
baseline_decisions.expected_old: Per-block center=True introduces internal padding frames.
baseline_decisions.expected_alternative: center=False removes that internal padding source; equality to whole-signal processing still depends on overlap/last block.

baseline_decisions.known: Early generator break leaves file/resampling resources open until GC unless .close() is called.
baseline_decisions.choice: If tokenizer stops early, close generator explicitly.
baseline_decisions.minimum_input: Read one yielded block then break, compare with try/finally stream.close().
baseline_decisions.expected_old: Resources can remain open until garbage collection.
baseline_decisions.basis: Caveat6; API documented expectation, not resource measurement.

baseline_decisions.known: Opening post proposes NaN-ignore scalar global bandwidth while retaining empty-neighbor errors for individual/pairwise estimation.
baseline_decisions.choice: Treat scalar estimator and pairwise estimator as different failure-responsibility branches. This is not new from B.
baseline_decisions.minimum_input: Constructed three-feature samples data=[[0.,0.1,100.]], k=1,sym=True,width=1,mode=affinity; candidate mutual-neighbor graph has a singleton and a0.1-distance pair. Verify that graph first.
baseline_decisions.expected_old: If all row neighbor maxima must exist, both scalar and pairwise paths error at isolated row.
baseline_decisions.expected_alternative: Requested scalar nanmedian excludes singleton and yields pair affinity exp(-0.1/0.1)=exp(-1); pairwise no-neighbor error remains.
baseline_decisions.basis: Issue lines6,11,33 plus common sym definition and exp(-distance/bandwidth). Public toy graph is a constructed proposed test, not executed or guaranteed by inspected implementation.

baseline_decisions.known: Common already defines arithmetic and geometric local scales, average-k scales, and adding the pair distance; includes Wang association.
baseline_decisions.choice: Changing from global to pairwise or arithmetic to geometric scaling is already available in common and cannot be claimed as a new B formula discovery.
baseline_decisions.minimum_input: Constructed local kth distances1 and4, pair distance2.
baseline_decisions.basis: Parameters.bandwidth; arithmetic derivation only; does not resolve isolated-row failure.

baseline_decisions.known: For affinity, full=True ignores width and uses k only to estimate bandwidth.
baseline_decisions.choice: Do not label full=True a preserving repair without checking temporal exclusion and sparsity requirements.
baseline_decisions.minimum_input: Constructed four frames with a close pair whose index difference is below width=3; compare full=False andTrue.
baseline_decisions.expected_old: width filtering excludes that pair in sparse recurrence.
baseline_decisions.expected_alternative: full=True ignores width and can populate the pair.
